description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called VoiceWakeSettings for configuring voice wake functionality on macOS. It includes UI components for toggling settings, selecting microphones and locales, managing trigger words, and testing voice wake detection. It also manages microphone and locale discovery and monitors live audio levels.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct for configuring voice wake settings, including microphone and language selection, trigger words, and test functionality.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: Struct representing an audio input device with UID and name, conforming to Identifiable and Equatable.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: Struct for trigger words entries with unique ID.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the app state into local trigger entries.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Syncs local trigger entries back to app state.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word entry by ID.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops voice wake testing, managing the tester object and related state.

methods.name: chimeRow
methods.description: Creates a UI row for selecting or playing a chime sound.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a custom chime sound file.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets the chime selection and plays it.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Creates a text command from a transcript if trigger words are present.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates microphone name in app state based on selected microphone ID.

methods.name: loadLocalesIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads supported locales for speech recognition.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Generates a human-readable name for a locale.
